questions.question: What is v0.dev used for?
options: Generating React UI components from text descriptions
questions.explanation: v0.dev by Vercel generates production-ready React components from text descriptions — describe what you want and get code.

questions.question: Which platform offers free static website hosting?
questions.explanation: GitHub Pages hosts static sites for free at username.github.io. Vercel and Netlify also offer free tiers.

questions.question: What is the correct AI-assisted development workflow?
options: Copy AI code without reading it
questions.explanation: The best workflow: Plan your project, generate code with AI, customize it, debug issues, then deploy.

questions.question: What does SEO stand for?
questions.explanation: SEO = Search Engine Optimization — techniques to make your website rank higher on Google search results.

questions.question: Which meta tag is most important for SEO?
questions.explanation: The meta description appears in Google search results below your title. It should summarize your page in under 160 chars.

questions.question: What is GitHub Copilot?
options: An AI that auto-completes code in your editor
questions.explanation: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant that suggests code completions as you type in VS Code. Free for students.

questions.question: Which is the easiest way to deploy a website for free?
questions.explanation: Vercel deploys automatically when you push to git — no server setup needed. Just connect your repo and push.

questions.question: What is Bolt.new?
options: An AI tool that generates full-stack web apps from prompts
questions.explanation: Bolt.new generates complete web applications from text descriptions — frontend, backend, and database included.

questions.question: Why should you understand AI-generated code?
options: To debug issues and customize it for your needs
questions.explanation: AI code may have bugs or not match your needs exactly. Understanding it lets you debug, customize, and maintain it.

questions.question: What is responsive design?
options: A design that responds to clicks
A design that looks good on all screen sizes
questions.explanation: Responsive design adapts to different screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) using media queries and flexible layouts.
